inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Notification of Change in Space: Child Care Regulation was not notified before making changes to the infant room space. The infant room was switched with a Pre-K room.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Notification of Change in Space (26 TAC §746.301(2))

occurrences.finding: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric CPR: A caregiver counted in child/caregiver ratio did not have current training in pediatric cardiopulmonary resuscitation (CPR). The training certificate available for review had a renewal date of 10/2025.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric CPR (26 TAC §746.1315(b))

occurrences.finding: Transportation Safety Training -Director and Employee Complete 2 Hours Annually: The director did not have current training in Transportation Safety. The transportation training certificate available for review had a date of completion 10/1/2024.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Transportation Safety Training -Director and Employee Complete 2 Hours Annually (26 TAC §746.1316(a))

occurrences.finding: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking.: A caregiver counted in child/caregiver ratio did not have current training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking. The training certificate available for review had a renewal date of 10/2025.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking. (26 TAC §746.1315(a))

occurrences.finding: Diaper Changing Equipment - Smooth, Non-absorbent, Easy to Clean Surface: The diaper changing mat in the toddler room and Pre-k room were observed torn.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diaper Changing Equipment - Smooth, Non-absorbent, Easy to Clean Surface (26 TAC §746.3503(a))

occurrences.finding: Documentation PEDIATRIAC CPR-1st aid original certificate on file at center or copy available if licensing requests: A caregiver's pediatric first aid and pediatric CPR training certificate was not available for review during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documentation PEDIATRIAC CPR-1st aid original certificate on file at center or copy available if licensing requests (26 TAC §746.1329(c)(2))

occurrences.finding: Director Annual Training - Additional required topics: Both director's were missing annual training on the following topics:     (1)  Emergency preparedness;     (2)  Preventing and controlling the spread of communicable diseases, including immunizations;    (3)  Administering medication, if applicable, including compliance with 746.3803 of this chapter (relating to What authorization must I obtain before administering a medication to a child in my care?);    (4)  Preventing and responding to emergencies due to food or an allergic reaction;    (5)  Understanding building and physical premises safety, including identification and protection from hazards that can cause bodily injury such as electrical hazards, bodies of water, and vehicular traffic; and    (6)  Handling, storing, and disposing of hazardous materials including compliance with 746.3425 of this chapter (relating to Must caregivers wear gloves when handling blood or bodily fluids containing blood?).
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Annual Training - Additional required topics (26 TAC §746.1311(e))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: Two of four children's files reviewed did not have the children's current immunization record.     NOTE: One of the children's current immunization record was obtained during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §746.603(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device - Remove the infant from the device and place the infant in a crib as soon as possible: Two infants were asleep on a restrictive device (floor bouncer) for an undetermined amount of time  in the infant room.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device - Remove the infant from the device and place the infant in a crib as soon as possible (26 TAC §746.2426(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training- Required Content: A caregiver was missing annual training for training year 10/30/2023-10/29/2024 on the following topics:     (1)Emergency preparedness;  (2)Preventing and controlling the spread of communicable diseases, including immunizations;  (3)Administering medication, if applicable, including compliance with  ?746.3803 of this chapter (relating to What authorization must I obtain before administering a medication to a child in my care?);  (4)Preventing and responding to emergencies due to food or an allergic reaction;  (5)Understanding building and physical premises safety, including identification and protection from hazards that can cause bodily injury such as electrical hazards, bodies of water, and vehicular traffic; and  (6)Handling, storing, and disposing of hazardous materials including compliance with ?746.3425 of this chapter (relating to Must caregivers wear gloves when handling blood or bodily fluids containing blood?).
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training- Required Content (26 TAC §746.1309(e))

occurrences.finding: Diaper Changing Equipment - Smooth, Non-absorbent, Easy to Clean Surface: The diaper changing mat in the infant room and toddler room were observed torn.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diaper Changing Equipment - Smooth, Non-absorbent, Easy to Clean Surface (26 TAC §746.3503(a))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Fire Inspection Report, Including Written Approval for Above/Below Ground Level Care: The fire inspection report was not available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Fire Inspection Report, Including Written Approval for Above/Below Ground Level Care (26 TAC §746.801(11))

occurrences.finding: Personal use of electronic devices, such as cell phones, MP3 players, tablets, and video games: A caregiver was using a cell phone while caring for a group of children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Personal use of electronic devices, such as cell phones, MP3 players, tablets, and video games (26 TAC §746.1203(3)(D))

occurrences.finding: Arrangement of Napping Equipment -Provides Sufficient Walking and Work Space: During nap time, the mats were arranged right next to each other with no walk and work space for caregivers between each mat.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Arrangement of Napping Equipment -Provides Sufficient Walking and Work Space (26 TAC §746.2909(3))

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months: There was no current fire inspection. The last fire inspection was conducted on 06/09/22.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: A staff member interacted with children and present during transportation route prior to operation receiving background check eligibility notice.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: There was a small opening/gap on the bottom of a section of the chain link fence in the outdoor play area.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Restrictive device for time out: A child was placed in a highchair by a caregiver for biting a child.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Restrictive device for time out (26 TAC §746.2805(8))

occurrences.finding: Safety Requirements for Cribs - Snug Fitting Sheets: A 7 month old was asleep in a crib in which the sheet did not completely cover the mattress.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Requirements for Cribs - Snug Fitting Sheets (26 TAC §746.2409(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Types of Vehicles Used to Transport Children - Be Maintained Safely: The transportation vehicle was observed with trash (candy wrappers, snack crumbs, and on AA battery)  on the floor.     Note: The trash was picked up during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Types of Vehicles Used to Transport Children - Be Maintained Safely (26 TAC §746.5603(c))

occurrences.finding: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Emergency Medical Information: There was no emergency medical transport and treatment authorization form for twelve children who are transported from school to the childcare operation.      Corrected at Inspection: Copies of the emergency medical transport and treatment authorization were placed in the transportation binder.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Emergency Medical Information (26 TAC §746.5617(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: One cockroach was observed crawling on the wall in the infant classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Sanitation Inspection Report: The current health/sanitation inspection report was not available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Sanitation Inspection Report (26 TAC §746.801(12))

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: Recite: There was one caregiver caring for 6 infants. The specified age for the group was 12-17months which allows 5 infants to 1 caregiver.     Note The ratios were left in compliance as an additional caregiver was put in the classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric CPR: A caregvier did not have a current CPR training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric CPR (26 TAC §746.1315(b))

occurrences.finding: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Proper Depth Maintained: Recite: Loose fill surfacing (mulch) was not observed to be maintained at the proper depth for a play structure in the outdoor play area. The dirt and grass underneath the mulch was visible.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Proper Depth Maintained (26 TAC §746.4907(d))

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: There was one caregiver caring for 6 infants. The specified age for the group was 12-17months which allows 5 infants to 1 caregiver.     Note The ratios were left in compliance as an additional caregiver was put in the classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Children's Records: Two personnel records were not available for review.    The current fire inspection was now available for review.     The infant feeding instructions for one infant was now available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Children's Records (26 TAC §746.801(1))

occurrences.finding: Adequate Lighting During Naptime: There was no adequate lighting during nap time for a school age group of children. The children were sharing a blanket and the caregiver was unable to see them because of the darkness in the room.     Note: A lamp was turned on in the room for appropriate lighting.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Adequate Lighting During Naptime (26 TAC §746.2911)

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Children's Records: The staff personnel records were not available for review.    The current fire inspection was not available for review.     The infant feeding instructions for one infant was not available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Children's Records (26 TAC §746.801(1))

occurrences.finding: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Proper Depth Maintained: Loose fill surfacing (mulch) was not observed to be maintained at the proper depth for a play structure in the outdoor play area. The dirt and grass underneath the mulch was visible.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Proper Depth Maintained (26 TAC §746.4907(d))

occurrences.finding: No Blocked or Locked Doors as Exits: The main entrance exit door was locked during operating hours.
occurrences.violation_type_title: No Blocked or Locked Doors as Exits (26 TAC §746.5209(c))

occurrences.finding: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Keep Separate from Food and Inaccessible to Children: There were cleaning supplies accessible to the children in care. There was liquid cleaner, Pine-Sol, on the floor in front of the water dispenser used by the children. There was a bleach container on top of the water sink used by the children.     Note: The cleaning supplies were removed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Keep Separate from Food and Inaccessible to Children (26 TAC §746.3407(12))

occurrences.finding: Safety Requirements for Play Yards - Use and Clean According to Manufacturer's Instructions: The play yards were observed with plywood on the bottom for support.   The play yards were not labeled with the infant s name.     Note: The play yards were labeled, and the plywood boards were removed from the play yards.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Requirements for Play Yards - Use and Clean According to Manufacturer's Instructions (26 TAC §746.2411(1))

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Not Used During Eating or Rest Times: A group of children were watching a movie during snack time.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Not Used During Eating or Rest Times (26 TAC §746.2207(c)(4))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Bodies of Water Inaccessible to Children: There was a bucket of water in the kitchen area which is in an open area and accessible to the children in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Bodies of Water Inaccessible to Children (26 TAC §746.3701(8))
